name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Vital Health Saunas are unique in many ways and their quality withstand many years on the market, providing the finest saunas for leisure and health. The company itself began from one man with back problems after a long career at the Navy, looking for a new way to relieve pain without pills and special treatments.



A combination of engineering and electronics together with healthcare and wellness creates the very best infrared sauna unit for gaining a great deal of health benefits for many years – the very thing that helps to change the world and make it a better place for many people.



Vital Health Saunas cares for its clients, and that is why each unit is maximum of everything: quality, technology, energy efficiency and safety. And to top that – awesome customer service, exquisite craftsmanship and very affordable prices for such a great offer on the market.
